label: training-gym-r62-complete
context:
Training Gym R62 completed! ALL 4 PASS ON FIRST TRY!

R62 RESULTS (all 10/10, all clean):
1. skip-list-001 (T9) - Skip List with randomized levels. Sentinel header, forward pointers per level. Range query via level-0 scan.
2. btree-001 (T9) - B-Tree with min degree t. Proactive splitting on insert. Split pushes median up.
3. dp-lcs-001 (T7) - LCS with 2D DP. Backtrack: diagonal = match, up/left = skip.
4. dp-matrix-chain-001 (T8) - Matrix chain with optimal split tracking. O(n^3) DP. Parenthesization via recursive split table.

DB: 281 exercises, 487 attempts, avg 9.89, 94.7% perfect. 231 passed. Tier 9+ = 61.
28+ consecutive rounds all 10/10.
decisions: Skip List: randomized level via coin flips. Insert: track update[] per level, splice in new node. Search: scan top-down.
B-Tree insert: if root full, split first. Always insert into leaf. Proactive split: split full children on the way down.
LCS: dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1]+1 if match, else max(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1]). Backtrack diagonally on match.
Matrix chain: dp[i][j] = min over k of dp[i][k]+dp[k+1][j]+dims[i-1]*dims[k]*dims[j]. Track split table for reconstruction.
next_steps: R63: Push further. Try: AVL Tree, Red-Black Tree, Bloom Filter, or advanced DP.
